note: Registry of project skills. active = exists on disk under .agents/skills; planned = approved by the AI-first harness plan, created in a later wave. Validated bidirectionally by scripts/studio/check-skills.mjs.

skills.name: runtime-producer
skills.activation: Orca coordination: task DAGs, supervision loops, workspace board sync; never product implementation

skills.name: runtime-architecture
skills.activation: architecture/authority analysis, R3 changes, ADR/spec boundary decisions

skills.name: runtime-implement
skills.activation: bounded generic code implementation tasks when no dedicated active domain skill owns the work

skills.name: runtime-content
skills.activation: historical/game content and compiler inputs: provenance, stable IDs, chronology, validation

skills.name: runtime-ui
skills.activation: React/Storybook UI work: density, accessibility, stories/tests, no renderer state ownership

skills.name: runtime-test
skills.activation: independent fresh read-only testing of a candidate against acceptance criteria

skills.name: runtime-review
skills.activation: independent fresh read-only review producing finding-contract candidates

skills.name: runtime-balance
skills.activation: closed balance tuning/weights/thresholds with schema validation, derived checks and deterministic gameplay evidence

skills.name: runtime-scenario
skills.activation: typed scenario-v1 authoring, compilation, capability resolution, certification and existing gamectl scenario commands

skills.name: runtime-simulation
skills.activation: deterministic simulate/compare, fixtures, repro/replay/trace/explain and property evidence

skills.name: runtime-persistence
skills.activation: after Rust-owned read-only persistence inspection/save devtools exist

skills.name: runtime-harness
skills.activation: after Studio/CI harness ownership is separated from broad game-semantic tooling paths
